Aufgaben

Deine Rolle

Du führst eigene Kundenetats von Briefing bis Reporting, verhandelst selbst mit Creators und Managements und vertrittst deine Kalkulation auch dann, wenn der Kunde drückt. Ab dem ersten Monat führst du Kundencalls allein. Wir führen nicht eng, wir delegieren.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Kampagnenleitung: Du steuerst Influencer-Kampagnen eigenverantwortlich, von der Konzeption bis zum Reporting, organisch und mit Paid-Anteil.

  • Verhandlung: Du verhandelst Honorare, Buy-Outs, Nutzungsrechte und Exklusivität mit Creators und Managements.

  • Kalkulation: Du stellst Kampagnenbudgets auf (Media, Produktion, Buy-Out, Agenturfee, Marge) und verteidigst sie.

  • Key Accounts: Du bist Hauptansprechpartner:in für deine Kunden und berätst sie zu Trends, Budgetverteilung und Skalierung.

  • Netzwerk: Du pflegst und erweiterst unsere Kontakte zu Managements, Agenturen und Creators.

  • Team: Du gibst dein Wissen weiter und unterstützt jüngere Projektmanager:innen.

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Influencer- oder Creator-Marketing auf Agentur- oder Brand-Seite, davon mit eigener Budgetverantwortung.

  • Du hast Honorare und Buy-Outs selbst mit Creators oder deren Management verhandelt.

  • Du kannst eine Kampagnenkalkulation eigenständig aufstellen.

  • Du hast Kundencalls allein geführt und Entscheidungen vertreten, auch unangenehme.

  • Du wohnst im Raum Köln oder ziehst her.

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und sicheres Englisch im Kundenkontakt.

Schön, wenn du Performance- oder CPA-Modelle im Creator-Marketing kennst, TikTok-first denkst, eigene Creator-Kontakte mitbringst oder schon fachlich geführt hast.

Benefits

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Verantwortung: eigene Etats und direkter Einfluss auf den Erfolg der Agentur.

  • Growth: Raum für deine Entwicklung in Richtung Team Lead oder Head of.

  • Hybrid: flexible Arbeitszeiten, Homeoffice und Office, mittwochs ist unser Office Day.

  • Vibe: junges, ehrgeiziges Team, flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege.

  • Equipment und Perks: MacBook, modernes Office im Herzen von Köln, Jobticket, regelmäßige Teamevents.

So bewirbst du dich

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und zwei Sätze zu einer Kampagne, auf die du stolz bist: Budget, Ergebnis, dein Anteil. Nenn uns gern auch deinen frühesten Start und deine Kündigungsfrist. Wir melden uns innerhalb von 2 Werktagen.

Your Mission:

We are looking for a Senior Mechanical Systems Engineer (all genders) to help us design and develop the mechanical systems on board our fully battery-electric aircraft (CS-23). You will contribute to the definition and development of key aircraft mechanical systems, including the Environmental Control System, landing gear, ice protection, interiors and other mechanical systems. Your work will span the full system development lifecycle, from system-level requirements, architecture and functional analysis through preliminary and detailed design, supplier involvement, testing and certification. You will work closely with overall aircraft design, structures, flight physics, propulsion and other engineering teams to ensure optimal system integration and will play a key role in the detailed definition of the overall aircraft.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Define and derive system-level requirements for mechanical aircraft systems based on CONOPS, aircraft-level requirements and applicable regulations.

  • Perform system-level functional analysis, including functional decomposition and identification of system interfaces.

  • Contribute to the definition and development of mechanical systems to achieve the required level of maturity at each aircraft design phase.

  • Define and manage functional and physical interfaces between mechanical systems and other aircraft disciplines.

  • Collaborate with partners and suppliers as a technical interface for mechanical systems.

  • Support Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA) and system safety activities in accordance with ARP4754A, ARP4761A and applicable certification requirements.

  • Support system integration, verification, testing and certification activities.

 

Your Profile:

  • Engineering degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.

  • 8+ years of aerospace experience, with a focus on aircraft mechanical systems.

  • Experience with systems engineering, including requirements definition, functional analysis and system integration.

  • Knowledge and experience in mechanical aircraft systems, preferably cabin Environmental Control System and/or landing gear.

  • Experience across the aircraft development lifecycle, including EASA/FAA Part 23 or 25 certification.

  • Experience working in an EASA Part 21J organization, or international equivalent.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; another European language is a plus.

  • Proactive, solution-oriented and comfortable taking ownership in a fast-paced environment.

  • Passionate about aviation and the electrification of flight.

  • Experience with electric or hybrid-electric aircraft and strong understanding of aircraft systems.

  • Experience working in an aerospace startup or new aircraft development programme.

  • Previous CVE or equivalent technical authority responsibility for one or more mechanical systems on a CS-23 aircraft programme.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

Mach Vereinsgeschichten sichtbar

Du fühlst Dich auf dem Sportplatz wohl, gehst gerne auf Menschen zu und hast Ideen für Videos, die man sich bis zum Ende anschaut? Du stehst selbst gerne vor der Kamera und kannst Deine Inhalte eigenständig drehen und schneiden?

Wir bei stickerfive entwickeln und produzieren individuelle Stickeralben für den Amateur- und Profisport sowie für Unternehmen und besondere Themenwelten. Bei uns bekommen Vereinsmitglieder ihren eigenen Sticker, Fans sammeln ihre Mannschaft und am Spielfeldrand wird getauscht.

Dahinter stecken Geschichten, die wir auf Social Media bisher viel zu selten erzählen. Unsere Kanäle und unsere Reichweite möchten wir deshalb gezielt ausbauen. Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der diesen Bereich mit eigenen Ideen und praktischer Erfahrung voranbringt.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Content entwickeln und produzieren: Du setzt Ideen für Reels, TikToks und Stories um. Vom Konzept über den Dreh bis zum Schnitt und zur Veröffentlichung begleitest Du Deine Inhalte selbst.

  • Vor der Kamera stehen: Du stellst unsere Sammelaktionen vor, führst kurze Interviews und gibst Einblicke in den Alltag bei stickerfive.

  • Vereine begleiten: Du besuchst Fotoshootings, Verkaufsstarts und Tauschbörsen. Dabei fängst Du die Stimmung ein und kommst mit den Menschen vor Ort ins Gespräch.

  • Unsere Kanäle betreuen: Du entwickelst einen Redaktionsplan, veröffentlichst regelmäßig und kümmerst Dich um Kommentare und Nachrichten.

  • Reichweite und Community aufbauen: Du entwickelst wiederkehrende Formate und Inhalte, die Menschen gerne anschauen, teilen und kommentieren. Passende Trends greifst Du auf und übersetzt sie in Ideen für stickerfive.

  • Ergebnisse auswerten: Du schaust Dir an, welche Inhalte funktionieren, und leitest daraus Verbesserungen ab. Dabei interessieren Dich beispielsweise Wiedergabedauer, geteilte Beiträge und die Entwicklung unserer Community.

  • Drehs und Inhalte organisieren: Du stimmst Dich mit unseren Vereinen sowie mit Grafik, Projektmanagement und Vertrieb ab. Du planst Termine und kümmerst Dich rechtzeitig um die Informationen und Materialien, die Du benötigst.

Was du mitbringst

Du hast bereits selbst Social-Media-Inhalte produziert und kannst uns konkrete Beispiele zeigen. Ob für ein Unternehmen, einen Verein oder Deinen eigenen Kanal, ist dabei zweitrangig. Uns interessiert, was Du selbst umgesetzt hast und was Du daraus gelernt hast.

Außerdem wünschen wir uns:

  • Interesse am Sport, besonders am Amateur- und Vereinsleben. Vielleicht bist Du selbst im Verein aktiv oder begleitest schon eine Mannschaft mit der Kamera.

  • Freude daran, vor der Kamera zu sprechen und auch auf fremde Menschen offen zuzugehen.

  • Einen sicheren Umgang mit Smartphone oder Kamera und einem Schnittprogramm wie CapCut, Premiere Pro oder DaVinci Resolve.

  • Ein Gespür für gute Einstiege, verständliche Geschichten und das passende Tempo eines Videos.

  • Gute deutsche Ausdrucksfähigkeit, sowohl beim Sprechen als auch beim Schreiben.

  • Eine selbstständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise. Du bringst Ideen ein, organisierst deren Umsetzung und sprichst offene Fragen oder Hindernisse frühzeitig an.

  • Bereitschaft zu Drehs bei unseren Partnervereinen, in der Regel am Wochenende.

Eine bestimmte Ausbildung oder ein Studium setzen wir nicht voraus. Deine Arbeitsproben und Deine Fähigkeiten zählen. Eine große eigene Followerschaft brauchst Du ebenfalls nicht.

Erfahrung mit bezahlter Werbung ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Du hast bereits mit Meta Ads oder TikTok Ads gearbeitet und Kampagnen zur Gewinnung neuer Interessenten betreut? Dann kannst Du diese Erfahrung bei uns einbringen und je nach Kenntnisstand auch Kampagnen übernehmen. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Content und dem Aufbau unserer Social-Media-Kanäle.

Dein Gestaltungsspielraum

Unser Social-Media-Auftritt (Facebook & Instagram) ist ziemlich mau. Auf TikTok sind wir noch nicht aktiv. Du kannst deshalb von Beginn an mitprägen, wie stickerfive auftritt.

Vielleicht begleitest Du eine Mannschaft, die zum ersten Mal ihr eigenes Album sieht. Vielleicht entwickelst Du ein Interviewformat am Spielfeldrand oder zeigst, wie aus einem Mannschaftsfoto ein Sticker wird. Wir suchen jemanden, der solche Ideen mitbringt und sie umsetzt.

Gemeinsam legen wir Ziele und Prioritäten fest. Du bekommst Raum, neue Formate auszuprobieren, und arbeitest eng mit den Menschen zusammen, die unsere Sammelprojekte betreuen.

Das erwartet Dich bei uns

  • Geschichten direkt aus dem Sport: Du lernst Amateurvereine kennen und erhältst Einblicke in unsere Projekte mit dem Profisport.

  • Kreativer Freiraum: Du entwickelst eigene Formate und prägst den Auftritt von stickerfive mit.

  • Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen: Du arbeitest direkt mit Grafik, Projektmanagement und Vertrieb zusammen.

  • Abwechslung zwischen Büro und Sportplatz: Dein Arbeitsplatz ist in Gräfelfing bei München. Wie oft Du wirklich am Ende vor Ort in Gräfelfing bei München oder im Homeoffice bist, kommt auf Deinen Wohnort an. Für Drehs bist Du auch bei unseren Partnervereinen unterwegs.

  • Ausstattung und Flexibilität: Du erhältst ein Firmenhandy und bei Bedarf auch einen Firmenlaptop. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten stimmen wir passend zu Drehs und Teamterminen ab.

  • Gemeinsame Erlebnisse: Ob Stadionbesuch oder Wiesn, auch außerhalb unserer Projekte unternehmen wir etwas zusammen.

  • Extras im Arbeitsalltag: Kostenlose Getränke und Kaffee sowie Mitarbeiterrabatte gehören ebenfalls dazu.

Zeig uns, was Du machst

Schick uns Deinen Lebenslauf oder einen kurzen Überblick über Deinen bisherigen Weg sowie Arbeitsproben. Besonders interessieren uns Videos, die Du selbst konzipiert, gedreht oder geschnitten hast. Bei gemeinsamen Projekten schreib bitte kurz dazu, welche Aufgaben Du übernommen hast.

Mindestens eines der Beispiele sollte Dich vor der Kamera zeigen. Falls Du dazu noch nichts Passendes hast, reicht auch ein kurzes Vorstellungsvideo mit dem Smartphone.

Erzähl uns außerdem, welchen Bezug Du zum Sport hast, wann Du anfangen könntest und welchen Stundenumfang und welches Gehalt Du Dir vorstellst.

Bewirb Dich direkt hier über die Plattform oder kontaktiere uns über unsere Kanäle

About PULT

PULT is the Workplace Presence & Visitor Platform for fast growing companies. We help IT, Workplace and People teams understand who is actually in the office, run compliant visitor management, and make better decisions about their space.

We are a Hamburg-based B2B SaaS company, backed by strong investors, with customers like VEVO, Wellhub and SG Fleet. We are post-seed, growing fast, and preparing the next stage of the company. Marketing is one of the biggest levers we have, and it still has a lot of untouched potential. That is where you come in.

Your first months at Pult

We are hiring a senior marketing / growth manager: one person who owns the full funnel, end to end, and scales what works. A bold, AI-native generalist who wants the whole board.

PULT is growing fast and opening international markets. You will turn it into a repeatable, measurable engine, and you will have the mandate, the budget and the backing to do it.

If you have been waiting for the role where you finally get to run marketing rather than a slice of it, this is it.

Your mission:

Demand generation

  • Plan and run paid campaigns across LinkedIn, Google and the channels you discover next, with full ownership of budget and ROI

  • Own the website and conversion funnel together with our web agency: messaging, landing pages, experiments

  • Build the organic engine: SEO, AI search visibility, content that IT and People leaders actually want to read

  • Run our webinar programme and turn it into a reliable pipeline source

Brand and storytelling

  • Sharpen PULT's positioning and make sure every touchpoint tells the same bold story

  • Produce standout content: campaigns, videos, case studies, product launches, founder and customer stories

  • Set a high bar for design and copy, and hold the team and agencies to it

Offline and events

  • Take PULT to the events that matter in DACH and the UK, from trade fairs to our own customer dinners and roundtables

  • Run account-based campaigns into our target accounts, online and offline, together with Sales

Engine and scale

  • Own the marketing stack (HubSpot, analytics, AI tooling) and the data behind it: attribution, CAC, MQL growth, pipeline contribution

  • Use AI as a force multiplier for research, content, creative and ops, and build the agents and workflows that let a small team move like a big one

  • Define the marketing roadmap, report on results to the leadership team, and hire the first marketing team members as we scale

What the role requires

  • A generalist with range. 3+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, ideally in a scale-up, with hands-on experience across paid, online and offline channels. You have run campaigns, written the copy, briefed the designer and read the dashboard yourself.

  • AI-native. You already work with AI every day: for research, content, creative, analysis and automation. You see where the tools are heading and you build with them, not around them.

  • High agency. You do not wait for a brief. You get excited by ambitious goals, find the path, and ship.

  • A storyteller with taste. Exceptional writing in English (German is a strong plus) and a sharp eye for design. You know the difference between content that fills a calendar and content that moves people.

  • Bold. You would rather launch something people talk about than something safe that nobody notices. You bring ideas we have not thought of.

  • ROI first. You think in pipeline, not impressions. You are comfortable with budgets, CAC, conversion rates and the conversation with Sales about lead quality.

  • International. You have experience in DACH and / or UKI market. You excited about expanding into new markets.

  • A builder. You want to be the leading marketing hire, expand on the foundations, and grow into leading a team.

Benefits

This is a remote-first position. You will have access to career training to support your professional development. A company laptop is provided for your daily work. Stay active with a sport membership. Enjoy flexible working hours. Company stock options give you a stake in the company's growth. Paid co-working options are also available.

Compensation

EUR 50,000–65,000 per year

Join PULT

If you match most of these requirements and are ready to shape the future of workplaces across the world, we encourage you to apply. You will be joining an early-stage startup where your contributions directly impact growth and product adoption.

Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, our annual revenue is in the hundreds of millions USD and millions use our browser on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the DuckDuckGo subscription. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place.

 

Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role

Working on the Marketing and Communications Functional Team, you'll help shape how millions of people hear about DuckDuckGo, lead projects, and own key ongoing work.

 

As a Social Media And Communications Manager, you'll write social media copy, manage social media mentions and communities, coordinate proactive announcements, manage incoming press requests, regularly report out and keep track of key performance metrics and work on related projects. You'll be the directly responsible individual (DRI) on your own projects from scoping through postmortem, collaborating closely with product, design, legal, support, and leadership.

 

Example projects include:

About You

  • 6+ years in communications, including PR and social media, ideally in tech.

  • Excellent writing skills, with the ability to explain products clearly, without jargon.

  • Hands-on social media experience, including content development and community management on X, Facebook, Reddit, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Threads, and Bluesky.

data.description:
Die envago GmbH aus Leipzig entwickelt Software für Netz- und Messstellenbetreiber. Mit envago.EAST digitalisieren wir die Zählerablesung, inklusive KI-gestützter Zählerstandserkennung und Ableseportal für Endkunden. envago.WEST bildet Geräteprozesse wie den Zählerwechsel ab. Unsere Kunden sind Unternehmen der Energiewirtschaft, die sich auf funktionierende Prozesse verlassen müssen. Deshalb ist uns wichtig, dass unsere Software genau das tut, was der Kunde im Alltag braucht.

Deine Rolle

Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kunden und unserer Software. Du kennst unsere Produkte so gut wie ein Anwender und prüfst neue Funktionen, bevor sie zum Kunden gehen. Genau dieses Produktwissen macht dich im Gespräch mit Bestands- und Neukunden glaubwürdig.

Deine Aufgaben

Produkt & Test

- Du testest neue Funktionen und Releases fachlich aus Sicht unserer Kunden und nimmst sie ab.

- Du erstellst strukturierte Testszenarien und Testfälle und dokumentierst die Ergebnisse.

- Du beschreibst Fehler und Verbesserungsvorschläge so, dass unsere Entwicklung damit arbeiten kann.

- Du bringst Anforderungen und Feedback unserer Kunden in die Weiterentwicklung der Produkte ein.

Kunden & Vertrieb

- Du betreust unsere Bestandskunden als feste Ansprechperson: von Fragen zur Anwendung bis zur Weiterentwicklung der Zusammenarbeit.

- Du gewinnst neue Kunden. Dazu gehören Produktpräsentationen, Angebote und Verhandlungen.

- Du stellst envago auf Fachmessen und bei Kundenterminen vor (bis zu ca. 12 Reisetage im Jahr).

Dein Profil

- Du hast mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Kundenbetreuung, im Vertrieb oder im Produktumfeld, idealerweise mit B2B-Software.

- Du musst nicht programmieren können, hast aber ein gutes technisches Verständnis. Du willst verstehen, wie Software funktioniert und wie Kunden sie nutzen.

- Du arbeitest sorgfältig und strukturiert. Fehler, die anderen entgehen, fallen dir auf.

- Du trittst sicher und verbindlich gegenüber Kunden auf und verhandelst gern.

- Kenntnisse der Energiewirtschaft (Netzbetrieb, Messstellenbetrieb, Zählerwesen) sind von Vorteil.

- Deutsch sprichst du verhandlungssicher.

- Du besitzt einen Führerschein der Klasse B.

Was wir bieten

- Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen und direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung und zur Entwicklung

- Direkten Einfluss darauf, wie sich unsere Produkte weiterentwickeln

- Eine abwechslungsreiche Rolle zwischen Produkt, Kunden und Messe

Interesse?

Wir freuen uns über deine Bewerbung!

Company description:

Elliptic is the leader in digital asset decisioning, we have built the most comprehensive platform for efficiently extracting crypto data and intelligence across blockchains with the greatest accuracy.

Our platform’s unrivalled uptime, scalability, depth and breadth of our data and intelligence means exacting organisations choose Elliptic for their compliance, risk management, intelligence operations and blockchain infrastructure needs.

Founded in 2013, Elliptic is headquartered in London with offices in New York, Washington D.C., Miami, San Francisco, UAE, Singapore, Hong Kong and Tokyo. To learn more, visit www.elliptic.co and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

The Role

We’re looking for a data-driven marketer with a passion for delivering impactful, integrated campaigns and for maximizing the value of key industry partnerships. This is a high-impact role for someone ready to take full ownership of campaign delivery and continuously optimize engagement across the buyer journey.

The impact you will have:

Elliptic is at an inflection point, shifting from crypto compliance tool to data and AI intelligence platform. This role puts you at the centre of that story. You will own the campaign engine that moves prospects through the buyer journey across our four core segments: financial institutions, PSPs, crypto natives, and government. You will also own the industry relationships that keep Elliptic visible and credible in the markets that matter. Done well, this role directly shapes the pipeline, not just awareness.

What you will do:

Plan and execute integrated multi-channel campaigns from brief to measurement, with clear accountability for business contribution at each stage, from awareness to pipe generation.

  • Own Elliptic's industry memberships and associations end to end: selecting the right ones, managing the relationships, and making sure each one delivers measurable return.

  • Build and run a newsletter and nurture programme that earns its audience rather than just occupying inboxes.

  • Design, build, and manage a data-driven newsletter and nurture programme that delivers engaging content and strengthens relationships with our audience.

  • Own the social calendar with a clear point of view on what Elliptic should be saying and where.

  • Partner with Field Marketing to adapt global campaigns for regional markets without losing precision.

  • Brief the Creative team with rigour: clear audience, clear objective, clear measure of success.

  • Partner with the Events team to ensure the success of global events and webinars - supporting end-to-end execution, driving registrations, and amplifying post-event impact.

  • Work closely with the Content Strategist to identify gaps, develop high-performing assets and ensure that content supports each stage of the buyer lifecycle.

  • Continuously explore new channels, creative approaches, and tools—using data to refine and strengthen campaign performance.

  • Measure performance using marketing analytics. Present insights and actionable recommendations for improving campaign ROI and audience engagement.

  • Use AI tools and modern marketing practices to streamline processes, increase productivity, and foster innovation.

You will be a great fit if you:

  • Take ownership of outcomes, not just activities. You care whether the campaign worked, not just whether it shipped.

  • You are comfortable with data and use it to make decisions rather than to report backwards.

  • You think in buyer journeys: you know how to move someone from unaware to in-conversation and you design accordingly.

  • You have genuine curiosity about the crypto and digital assets space, not as a box to tick but because you find it interesting.

  • You can work at pace without losing quality, and you hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is checking.

Our ideal candidate has:

  • Proven experience planning and executing integrated B2B campaigns with measurable pipeline impact.

  • Strong working knowledge of HubSpot or an equivalent marketing automation platform.

  • Experience managing industry partnerships or memberships with a commercial lens, not just an admin one.

  • Solid understanding of LinkedIn, X, Reddit etc as B2B channels, including both organic and paid.

  • Experience in a regulated sector, fintech, or crypto environment, or a strong, demonstrable interest in the space.

  • Excellent written communication: clear, direct, and built for the channel it is on.

  • Previous experience or knowledge of the crypto space or regulated sector

How we work:

  • Hybrid working and the option to work from almost anywhere for up to 90 days per year

  • £500 Remote working budget to set up your home office space

  • Holidays: 25 days of annual leave + bank holidays

  • An extra day for your birthday

  • Enhanced parental leave: we provide eligible employees, regardless of gender or whether they become a parent by birth or adoption, 16 weeks fully-paid leave and leave.

> Benefits:

  • Private Health Insurance - we use Bupa!

  • Full access to Spill Mental Health Support

  • Life Assurance: we hope you will never need this - but our cover is for 4 times your salary to your beneficiaries

We know Diversity and Inclusion is much deeper than just hiring, but it’s important for us to mention it here. We welcome and embrace individuals of all backgrounds and identities at Elliptic, and this is an ongoing priority for us. We know incredible people don’t all think in the same way. We want to be challenged every day. We believe our diverse team of individuals underpins this by bringing creative thinking and innovation to Elliptic every day. We are committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and equitable workplace, so we welcome applications from everyone, even if you may not think you fit all of the requirements of our roles. We foster an environment of psychological safety, where everyone feels comfortable to bring their whole self to work.

Senior Data Scientist - Credit Risk Modelling

Hybrid in London or remote in the UK

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Credit Risk Modelling team.

You'll shape how iwoca models credit risk – setting the technical direction on multi-quarter projects, and lifting the bar for the team as you go.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Credit Risk Modelling team owns credit risk and Customer Lifetime Value (CLtV) modelling for iwoca's UK and German lending. That covers the probabilistic machine learning models behind every credit decision, plus the CLtV models that shape pricing and portfolio strategy.

The team is around twelve data scientists. Some work on auto-space models that decide within five minutes from data candidates authorise us to pull. Others work on manual-space models that pick up when a credit analyst adds digital footprint and income data, which lands a decision within 24 hours.

The role

You'll own credit and CLtV modelling projects end to end, from spotting where the modelling stack is holding the business back through to landing the change. The work spans keeping production models healthy, incremental development, and research that reshapes how the models work. AI has lowered the cost of prototyping enough that ideas which used to sit below the priority line are now viable, so the R&D share of the role is growing.

Live examples of the work:

  • Causal estimation of offer terms. Modelling how amount, duration, and price shape customer outcomes.

  • Unifying auto and manual models. The two families were built without forced technical alignment. Finding a principled way to unify them on a common cost function is open work.

  • IFRS accounting model. A multi-stage credit model where information propagates back from later-stage recovery predictions to sharpen upfront loss estimates.

  • Generalising credit and CLtV. Whether a more general framing could replace both separate models is an open research question.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

  • Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field. You reason about uncertainty and calibration as first-order concerns.

  • Production ML. You have built and shipped supervised ML models end to end – exploration, training, deployment, monitoring.

  • Research mindset. You proactively explore new ways to add value. R&D time is when you expect to find the next step change.

  • Judgement. You critically evaluate model output – yours, a colleague's, or an LLM's – and can explain why a choice is right. You defend your reasoning under challenge, and challenge others' when the evidence points elsewhere. You've influenced technical direction beyond your own projects.

  • Project leadership. You've owned modelling projects end to end, from spotting the opportunity through framing, method choice, shipping, and landing the commercial impact. You move fast, iterate, and update on new evidence rather than chase perfection.

  • AI fluency. You use AI as a primary tool. You prototype with it, automate with it, and take on R&D that would not otherwise be viable. You use judgement on where it helps and where it doesn't.

Bonus:

  • Domain experience. You have worked in credit risk, lending, or customer lifetime value modelling.

  • Non-linear methods. You have shipped gradient boosting or neural networks on tabular data in production.

  • Bayesian methods. You have used hierarchical models, MCMC, or Bayesian updating in real work.

  • Time series modelling. You have modelled temporal data where autocorrelation, drift, or seasonality mattered.

  • Python. The stack the team uses.

The salary

We expect to pay from £90,000 – £120,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

Harvey is looking for a Compensation Business Partner to ensure our compensation philosophy, principles, and practices extend to all of our markets outside of the US, initially focused on EMEA and APAC.

This will be our first Compensation Business Partner dedicated to our international business sitting within the EMEA region, and an opportunity to help shape how Harvey approaches compensation as we continue to scale globally. You’ll partner closely with our People Business Partners, Recruiting team, business leaders, and the broader Compensation team to ensure our programs remain competitive, thoughtful, and scalable across markets.

We’re looking for someone who combines deep compensation expertise with strong business judgment. You should be equally comfortable analyzing market data, advising a recruiter on a complex offer, partnering with a PBP and developing a point of view on how Harvey should approach compensation in a new or rapidly evolving market. This is a highly collaborative role that will have a great degree of partnership across many functions.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the primary Compensation Business Partner for EMEA and APAC, developing deep context on our teams, talent markets, and hiring needs across the regions.

  • Partner closely with People Business Partners and business leaders on compensation decisions including new hires, promotions, internal mobility, and other complex compensation questions.

  • Build a particularly strong partnership with Recruiting, advising on offers, market competitiveness, and candidate-specific situations.

  • Help evolve Harvey's international compensation strategy as we scale, including our approach to geographic differentiation, market positioning, salary structures, and equity.

  • Bring deep equity expertise and help translate Harvey's equity philosophy across markets where candidate expectations and familiarity with US-style equity compensation can vary significantly.

  • Research emerging compensation practices and talent trends, particularly across the rapidly evolving AI market, and turn external data into clear recommendations for Harvey.

  • Conduct market analyses using compensation survey data and other sources, while applying judgment.

  • Partner with the broader Compensation team on compensation cycles, benchmarking, band development, and company-wide programs, ensuring international considerations are represented from the beginning.

  • Identify where our US practices translate internationally—and where they don't—and proactively recommend changes as Harvey enters and scales in new markets.

  • Help build the infrastructure, principles, and enablement that will allow Harvey's international compensation approach to scale.


What You Have

  • 5-7+ years of experience in compensation

  • Experience supporting international compensation across EMEA and/or APAC.

  • Experience working for a US-headquartered company, with a strong understanding of how global compensation programs are designed and adapted for international markets.

  • Meaningful experience with equity compensation, including the ability to explain and advise on equity in markets with different norms and expectations.

  • Experience in a high-growth startup or scale-up environment; you are comfortable building while the company and market are changing around you.

  • Strong knowledge of compensation fundamentals including market benchmarking, salary structures, job leveling, offers, promotions, retention, and pay decisions.

  • Exceptional business partnership skills. You can build trust with leaders, PBPs, and recruiters while being willing to challenge assumptions.

  • Strong analytical skills paired with excellent judgment—you know when the data is telling you something and when it requires additional context.

  • Intellectual curiosity and a genuine appetite to become an expert on the AI talent market, including proactively researching competitors, compensation trends, and emerging practices.

  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity and building new approaches rather than relying on an established playbook.

  • Ability to communicate complicated compensation concepts simply and credibly to audiences with very different levels of compensation expertise.

LA MAISON JACQUEMUS

 

Jacquemus was founded by Simon Porte Jacquemus in 2009 in Paris, France.

Dedicated to the memory of the designer’s late mother, the brand draws inspiration from a passion for culture. The Jacquemus ready-to-wear and accessories collections for men and women reference the French way of life and universal gestures of beauty, encompassing influences from fine art photography to decorative arts, cinema, painting, and sculpture.

 

Throughout the years, Jacquemus has staged runway productions in unique and unexpected locations, including a Parisian swimming pool, the Musée Picasso, a lavender field in Provence, a wheat field outside Paris, a salt marsh in the Camargue, and a beach in Hawaii. More recently, the brand has embraced settings such as the canal of the Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), the Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), Casa Malaparte (La Casa) and Auguste Perret’s Parisian apartment (La Croisière).

 

Based in the 8th arrondissement of Paris, Jacquemus is an independent fashion house with over 300 employees. Renowned for its fast-growing digital presence and its worldwide business spread, the brand has created innovative retail experiences around the world before opening its first permanent flagship store at 58 Avenue Montaigne in Paris in 2022. Following this milestone, international boutiques have opened in New York (SoHo), London (New Bond Street), Los Angeles (Melrose Avenue) and Dubai.

At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.

Kpler is expanding into high-value maritime verticals, with Cruise Liners and Port Operations representing two important opportunities. Both address a common market need: the lack of independent, reliable insights into actual performance, built on observed data rather than published schedules or self-reported information.

In the cruise sector, operators and analysts often rely on published itineraries rather than actual vessel movements, despite the significant fuel and carbon costs associated with fleet operations. In ports, performance data is often incomplete or self-reported, creating a need for independent benchmarking as berth-level emissions carry increasing financial implications under schemes such as the EU ETS.

As a Senior Product Manager, Cruise Liners & Port Operations, you will own both products end to end, from strategy and roadmap through to the first release and go-to-market. Working closely with the Lead Product Manager – Maritime & Logistics, you will build two early-stage products in parallel, leveraging Kpler’s network of more than 13,000 AIS receivers and over 10,000 mapped ports and berths.

For Cruise Liners, you will develop itinerary intelligence for tracked fleets, providing an independent view of actual sailed itineraries, fuel consumption and emissions. For Port Operations, you will build a product focused on port-level vessel activity monitoring, giving port authorities a reliable, live view of activity and performance.

This is an individual-contributor role for an experienced product professional with a background in maritime, cruise, travel, ports or an adjacent B2B data/SaaS environment. You will need to balance competing priorities across two products, establish trusted data methodologies, engage customers and bring both products to market through a pragmatic, build-and-iterate approach.

Hi, we’re Bloom & Wild. We don’t just send flowers. We help our customers to care wildly. Caring wildly is celebrating the little things we all do for each other every day. Not just the big occasions. It’s being there for the highs. Stepping up for the lows.
 
We care wildly about people and our planet. Which is why we’re so proud to be a certified B Corp™ – committed to making long-term positive change for our community, and the world around us.
 
Founded in 2013, our mission back then was to make sending and receiving flowers the joy that it should be, by harnessing technology, brand and letterbox delivery. We announced £75 million Series D funding in 2021 and that same year acquired bloomon in The Netherlands and Bergamotte in France. Together, we’ve fulfilled and delivered over 20 million orders (and counting!), making us the largest direct to consumer flower business in Europe.
 
Now home to a family of 3 beautiful brands, we’re driven by our vision to create the destination for making life a little more thoughtful and beautiful. And we won't stop at flowers and plants. Starting with the Bloom & Wild brand, we're expanding our gifting offering to other categories like cakes, candles and cocktails. This is all part of our ambition to build Europe's #1 direct to consumer gifting destination. 

 

🛠️ The Commercial Team @ Bloom & Wild Group 

Our team cares wildly about delivering ambitious and profitable growth across all of our seven markets and three brands. We’re firmly focused on growing profitably, whilst also keeping an eye on the long term commercial view, and our wider business goals, in everything that we do.

This may sound like a cliché, but we really are a bunch of fast-thinking problem-solvers. Think Deeply, Act Swiftly really comes into play in our team. Our Slack channels are full of threads of our team coming together to solve a problem, sharing knowledge and resources, and all working together for our shared mission. We know where we’re headed, and we’re all ready to jump in to support each other to get there. We develop our commercial strategy whilst managing day to day trading to have full country or category oversight.

We’re a distributed team, and we currently have team members all across Europe & the UK! This role is based in our London or Amsterdam office with an expectation of being in the office 2 days a week (can be remote in Germany too), with full office presence and travelling to our Amsterdam office over peak timings. We work very frequently with almost all other functions across the business, so we’re really proud of our ability to collaborate effectively and are always looking for ways to connect and work together; making use of both our virtual tools and our lovely offices. We come together as a full team once a year in either London or Amsterdam for a team offsite, and throughout the rest of the year we gather in our respective country teams as frequently as we can! 

💻 What you’ll be doing: 

Reporting to our Commercial Director Germany & Austria, you'll own the trading function for Europe, one of our most important growth markets. You'll make sure we have the right stock every day, sell it to forecast and keep waste to a minimum. You'll also hold the pen on site pricing and make sure our website is set up to convert. You'll work across teams in a matrix structure, alongside our operations, central planning, range and product design teams, and play a key role in delivering our biggest peaks: Christmas, Valentine's Day and Mother's Day. It's a fast-paced, collaborative environment where no two days are the same and you can make an impact from day one.

Some of the responsibilities include:


Stock and forecasting:

  • Managing our day-to-day and week-to-week stock position with our central planning, flower buying and operations teams, keeping availability strong and balancing supply when there are shifts in demand and customer preferences

  • Making sure we have the volume and variety of stock available and sell it to forecast. You'll draw on past data, customer behaviour and the market calendar (e.g. public holidays) to keep waste to a minimum

  • Feeding into our longer-term forecasts, using customer insight and market context to decide where we grow specific SKUs and products. 


    • Pricing and range:

  • Holding the pen on site pricing, finding the right balance between selling price and margin, based on understanding of the overall product cost structure

  • Working closely with the range team on bestsellers, market needs and pricing architecture to ensure we’ve got a range of gifts priced for all customer’s shopping missions. 


    • On-site experience:

  • Owning the on-site experience, using stock levels, product naming and product ordering to grow or rebalance customer demand as needed

  • Making sure the right demand drivers are visible, and running the right tests for where the market is today

  • Managing the on-site AB testing roadmap from idea to launch for the European market and working with our BI team's insights to deliver next steps.


    • Peak trading:
  • Preparing for and delivering our peak gifting moments: Christmas, Valentine's Day and Mother's Day. You'll work with our forecasting and planning team to get order volume and delivery date forecasts as accurate as possible, maximising growth while minimising waste. 

    • Trading:

  • Preparing the regular trading meeting agendas and opening each meeting with the market context we need to make decisions across teams

  • Building strong relationships with our in-house operations, central planning, range and product design teams

  • Working with our UK and Netherlands trading teams and supporting trading in other markets. 


    • AI and automation:

  • Building and embedding AI tools and agents into our day-to-day trading, from automating daily forecasting inputs to spotting emerging trends in customer demand, so we can make faster, better-informed decisions. 

  • Collaborating on bigger impact  AI projects across our trading teams and other stakeholders in the business, so the best tools and workflows are rolled out across markets.

  • Are collaborative with excellent communication, relationship and stakeholder management skills
  • Are a proactive team member - you take ownership and get stuck in, and you're able to balance multiple projects and priorities
  • Are intellectually curious - you love to tackle problems with others
  • You care about the detail and consistently deliver excellent work
  • Are an empathetic decision maker - you put customers first and seek to understand what will work for them
  • Are innovative - you enjoy new tech, testing, learning and trying new things
  • Are enthusiastic and driven, with a positive outlook
  • Have proven experience of using AI tools to improve how you work, e.g. automating reports or streamlining analysis.

  • Strong Excel / Google Sheets ability and are comfortable managing, building & interpreting data models
  • An analytical mindset and demonstrable experience of a strong numerical skillset (a background in STEM is a plus)

Hi, we’re Bloom & Wild. We don’t just send flowers. We help our customers to care wildly. Caring wildly is celebrating the little things we all do for each other every day. Not just the big occasions. It’s being there for the highs. Stepping up for the lows.
 
We care wildly about people and our planet. Which is why we’re so proud to be a certified B Corp™ – committed to making long-term positive change for our community, and the world around us.
 
Founded in 2013, our mission back then was to make sending and receiving flowers the joy that it should be, by harnessing technology, brand and letterbox delivery. We announced £75 million Series D funding in 2021 and that same year acquired bloomon in The Netherlands and Bergamotte in France. Together, we’ve fulfilled and delivered over 20 million orders (and counting!), making us the largest direct to consumer flower business in Europe.
 
Now home to a family of 3 beautiful brands, we’re driven by our vision to create the destination for making life a little more thoughtful and beautiful. And we won't stop at flowers and plants. Starting with the Bloom & Wild brand, we're expanding our gifting offering to other categories like cakes, candles and cocktails. This is all part of our ambition to build Europe's #1 direct to consumer gifting destination.

    1. An initial chat with Chloe from Talent Acquisition

About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

The role

Support at Dust is not a cost center. It is one of the most important product surfaces we own.

As a Senior AI Support Engineer, you will help define what world-class support looks like in an AI-native company. You will not just resolve tickets. You will own the systems, agents, workflows, and feedback loops that make support better, faster, and more scalable over time.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who has already operated close to support strategy, technical escalation, user experience, and automation. You should be excited by the idea of taking recurring customer pain and turning it into durable systems: better agents, better documentation, better internal tooling, sharper product feedback, and fewer repeat issues.

The best person for this role is not a traditional support leader who wants to manage a queue from a distance. It is someone with strong technical instincts, a deep user mindset, and a track record of building support systems that change how a team operates.

You might be a great fit if you have built an AI-powered support function, owned support tooling at scale, worked deeply with LLMs or automation, or carried a support strategy from problem discovery through implementation and measurement.

What you will own

Building the AI systems that make support scale

You will design, build, and continuously improve the AI-powered systems that help Dust support customers with speed and quality. This includes agents for ticket classification, auto-acknowledgement, response drafting, internal routing, proactive incident detection, knowledge retrieval, and escalation support.

You will identify categories of recurring issues and engineer them out of the support queue. Sometimes that means building a better Dust agent. Sometimes it means improving documentation, creating an internal tool, tightening a workflow, writing a script, or escalating product feedback upstream with enough context for engineering to act.

You will be expected to measure whether the systems you build actually improve the user experience. Seniority here means not just shipping tooling, but knowing what good looks like, instrumenting it, and iterating until the impact is visible.

Running complex support when the systems fall short

You will still be close to the work. You will investigate complex customer issues across logs, code, internal tooling, product behavior, and agent outputs. You will provide clear, accurate answers to customers, including when the underlying issue is ambiguous or technically complex.

You will handle escalated cases with precision and judgment, communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical users. You should be comfortable translating between customer language, product behavior, engineering detail, and business impact.

When AI-generated responses are incomplete, inconsistent, or wrong, you will debug the system behind them. You will improve prompts, knowledge sources, workflows, routing, tooling, and escalation paths so that the same failure mode does not repeat.

Shaping the support strategy

You will help define how Dust should run support as we scale. That means thinking beyond the queue and owning the full loop: what customers experience, what support sees, what agents can handle, what engineering needs to fix, and what product should learn.

You will translate repeated customer pain into high-quality product signal. You will build strong working relationships with engineers and product teams so escalations are high-context, actionable, and efficient.

You will also help raise the bar for how the support function operates: what we measure, how we prioritize, how we review quality, how we onboard junior team members, and how we decide what should be automated versus handled by a human.

What we are looking for

Every candidate and employee’s success at Dust is measured against the same three dimensions: Aptitude, Attitude, and Agency.

Aptitude

You have strong technical depth. You are comfortable with APIs, web applications, logs, scripts, and internal tools. You can navigate a codebase, reason through product behavior, and troubleshoot systems without being stopped by a stack trace.

You have genuine AI fluency at builder level. You have built agents, automations, workflows, or internal tools using AI systems such as Dust, Cursor, Claude Code, n8n, GPT-4, Claude, Mistral, Gemini, or similar platforms. You are not just good at prompting. You understand how to turn AI into operational leverage.

You have experience operating at the strategy layer of support, not only at the ticket layer. You have owned or helped shape support systems, support tooling, escalation workflows, deflection strategy, knowledge management, or AI support operations.

You can balance technical accuracy with user experience. You care about whether the customer understood the answer, whether the product pain was addressed, and whether the issue will happen again.

You are able to communicate bidirectionally: clearly enough for customers, technically enough for engineers, and strategically enough for leadership.

Attitude

You combine resilience with empathy. This is a front-line role, and customer frustration is often direct and unfiltered. You do not take it personally, but you do take it seriously.

You are proactive rather than reactive. You do not wait for a perfect problem statement from the customer. You investigate, infer, clarify, and anticipate what they may need next.

You have strong prioritization judgment. You know what needs an immediate human response, what can be automated, what should be escalated, and what should become product feedback.

You are comfortable setting boundaries. You do not say yes to everything, and you can explain tradeoffs clearly in a way that builds trust rather than eroding it.

You care about the craft of support. You see support as a product experience, not a back-office function.

Agency

You turn patterns into systems. When you see the same issue twice, you start asking whether it should exist at all.

You go deep before escalating. You investigate as far as you reasonably can, so that when you involve engineering or product, they receive a clear problem statement, relevant evidence, and a useful recommendation.

You build without waiting for permission. If you see a gap in the support system, you are excited to prototype, test, and ship a better version.

You continuously improve your own workflows. You treat your time, your tools, and your operating system as things worth debugging.

You extract product opportunities from customer interactions. You do not let support signal disappear into a solved ticket. You close the loop.

What strong candidates may have done before

You may have:

  • Built or led an AI-powered support function

  • Designed support agents, internal copilots, escalation workflows, or deflection systems

  • Owned technical support tooling, support operations, or automation at a fast-growing software company

  • Worked as a senior support engineer, technical support engineer, developer support engineer, support ops engineer, solutions engineer, or implementation engineer

  • Built a support product, internal platform, AI startup, or automation-heavy support system

  • Operated in a high-volume environment where quality, speed, and judgment all mattered

We care more about the depth and relevance of your experience than the exact number of years. That said, we expect this role to be a fit for someone who has already spent several years close to technical support, support engineering, AI tooling, or support systems ownership.

What this role is not

This is not a traditional customer support role focused only on ticket resolution.

It is not a people-management role where you are far away from the technical work.

It is not a pure operations role where you optimize process without building.

It is not a role for someone who is curious about AI but has not yet built with it.

The person we are looking for should be excited to own the messy middle between customers, AI agents, internal tooling, engineering, and product.

Compensation and benefits

  • Competitive compensation

  • Significant equity package in a Sequoia-backed startup

  • Substantial relocation support, up to 10k€, including help finding an apartment in Paris and support with the visa process

  • Health insurance for you and your dependents

  • New MacBook Pro or Linux machine, monitor, keyboard, and equipment

  • Beautiful office in the heart of Paris

  • Opportunity to travel to the US multiple times a year

  • Regular team events and offsites

We can go higher for exceptional profiles.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

Harmattan AI is seeking a Global Sourcing Manager Electronics to serve as a supply chain expert across electronic systems, including printed circuit boards (PCBs/PCBAs) and custom wire harnesses. In this strategic, high impact position, you will drive the procurement of essential parts, raw materials, and manufacturing services required to build our hardware. You will build resilient strategic supplier networks for emerging and legacy product lines, optimizing for technical capability, unit economics, and quality standards. Working closely with engineering, production, and business units, you will vet supplier capabilities, structure robust commercial terms, and proactively derisk a complex, rapidly scaling electronics supply chain.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and execute long term category roadmaps for PCBs, PCBAs, and cable harness assemblies, targeting cost optimization, quality control, supply resiliency, and full product lifecycle alignment.

  • Direct competitive bidding activities (RFIs, RFQs, RFPs) and strategic sourcing campaigns, maintaining ultimate accountability for part quality, timeline adherence, and target cost fulfillment.

  • Act as the primary relationship owner and escalation contact for Contract Manufacturers (CMs) and specialized board and harness fabricators, overseeing supply continuity, risk mitigation, price negotiations, and the transition from New Product Introduction (NPI) to full scale Mass Production (MP).

  • Collaborate with Hardware Engineering and manufacturing partners to refine design specifications, align production processes, and guide strategic CapEx and equipment investments.

  • Evaluate supplier quote structures through granular cost breakdown analysis, leveraging Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) models to guide procurement decisions.

  • Draft and settle commercial agreements, securing competitive unit pricing, favorable payment terms, and delivery schedules.

  • Work across internal functions to fulfill rapid prototyping needs, meet hardware build milestones, resolve technical bottlenecks, and integrate novel vendor technologies.

  • Lead operational initiatives around integrating new and adapted electronics technologies, delivering technical briefings and progress updates to executive leadership.

  • Establish vendor evaluation systems to track key performance metrics across quality, operational execution, cost variance, and continuous innovation.

Candidate Requirements

  • Educational Background: Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • Relevant Experience: 6+ years of specialized experience managing electronic commodities (PCB/PCBA, custom cabling, wire harnesses) within a high tech sourcing or supply chain engineering environment.

  • Technical Aptitude: Advanced proficiency in Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) modeling and data driven vendor evaluation within complex hardware architectures.

  • Commodity Strategy: Demonstrated ability to craft clear commodity strategies in direct collaboration with engineering leadership.

  • Proven Leadership: Strong cross functional leadership skills, with a track record of driving alignment across diverse teams.

  • Adaptability & Mobility: Highly adaptable, hands on professional who thrives in a fast paced, dynamic environment, bridges operational gaps, and removes process friction.

  • Communication & Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication, capable of engaging a wide range of stakeholders, from junior members to senior executives.

  • Sector Exposure: Prior exposure to defense, aerospace, automotive, or high reliability technology sectors is strongly preferred.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

LA MAISON JACQUEMUS
 
Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.
Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).
 
 
VOTRE RÔLE
 
 
Rattaché(e) au Directeur Image, Le/la Head of Production Photos E-Commerce est responsable du pilotage global des productions photographiques  destinées à l’e-commerce et au showroom.

Il/elle supervise l’ensemble de la chaîne de production, de la planification des shootings à la livraison des images finales, en 
passant par la sélection des équipes créatives et techniques, la gestion des budgets et des plannings, ainsi que le suivi de la post production, de la retouche et du contrôle qualité.

Garant(e) du rendu visuel et de la conformité des images produites, il/elle assure la fluidité des flux d’images, l’optimisation des budgets et la coordination des équipes internes et des prestataires externes.

Le poste combine une forte dimension opérationnelle et managériale, un rôle de pilotage budgétaire et une responsabilité creative dans la réalisation des supports visuels.
 
 
 
 
 
 
VOS MISSIONS 
 
 

Pilotage de la production photographique e-commerce

  • Piloter l’ensemble des productions photographiques destinées au site e-commerce : packshots, visuels portés. 
  • Planifier et prioriser les shootings en fonction du calendrier des drops et des mises en ligne e-commerce, des besoins de publication et des échéances de livraison
  • Identifier les produits restant à shooter, les produits jamais photographiés et les produits présentant des non-conformités nécessitant une nouvelle prise de vue
  • Arbitrer les priorités de production en fonction des impératifs de mise en ligne, des volumes à traiter, des ressources disponibles et des budgets alloués
  • Organiser et superviser les shootings, de la préparation à la livraison finale des assets.
  • Assurer l’art buying : identification, sélection et coordination des équipes créatives et techniques (photographes, mannequins, stylistes et autres intervenants)
  • Création de moodboard 
  • Editer les images on set en cohérence avec la direction artistique et la mise en avnat du produit
  • Piloter les budgets, les plannings et les ressources nécessaires à la réalisation des productions
  • Superviser les étapes de post-production et de retouche, en garantissant le respect des standards de qualité attendus
  • Être garant(e) du rendu visuel, de la cohérence et de la qualité des images diffusées sur le site

 

Direction artistique, sélection et édition des images

  • Assurer une sélection et une édition des images dès la phase de shooting, en fonction de la direction artistique définie, desbesoins de communication et de la mise en valeur des produits
  • Faire preuve d’un œil créatif affirmé afin d’identifier les images les plus pertinentes, tant sur le plan esthétique que dans leur capacité à valoriser le produit, sa coupe, sa matière et ses détails
  • Arbitrer les choix de prises de vue et sélectionner les visuels les plus adaptés aux usages e-commerce et showroom, en 
    garantissant la cohérence du rendu visuel et le respect de l’identité de la marque
  • Collaborer avec les équipes créatives et les photographes pendant les shootings afin d’ajuster les prises de vue et les sélections en fonction des résultats obtenus et des objectifs visuels
  • Concevoir des moodboards de direction artistique en amont des productions afin de définir les intentions visuelles, les références, les cadrages et les orientations créatives des shootings

 

Pilotage de la production showroom et des lookbooks

  • Piloter l’organisation et la production des shootings destinés au showroom
  • Superviser la réalisation des lookbooks, de la préparation des prises de vue à la livraison des visuels finaux
  • Assurer le lien entre les besoins créatifs, les contraintes de production et les objectifs de livraison

 

Supervision de la post-production, de la retouche et des flux d’images

  • Superviser l’ensemble des processus de post-production, de la réception des prises de vue à la livraison des fichiers finaux
  • Piloter la retouche réalisée en interne et auprès de prestataires externes
  • Contrôler la conformité des visuels aux gabarits attendus, notamment en matière de cadrage, de format, de dimensions et de respect des standards de livraison
  • Vérifier les chromies et la fidélité colorimétrique des images afin de garantir la cohérence du rendu visuel et la fidélité réel des produits
  • Identifier et suivre les non-conformités produits détectées lors des shootings ou de la post-production, en coordonnant les actions correctives nécessaires
  • Déterminer les besoins de nouvelles prises de vue lorsque les images existantes sont absentes, incomplètes ou non conformes aux exigences de qualité
  • Anticiper les points de blocage et mettre en place les ajustements nécessaires pour garantir la fluidité des opérations.
  • Veiller à l’efficacité des méthodes de travail et à l’amélioration continue des processus de production et de post-production

 

Management et coordination des équipes

  • Manager et coordonner une équipe de 3 à 5 personnes au total quotidiennement et toutes les équipes externes pendant les shootings
  • Encadrer directement les fonctions liés à la production et à la coordination des visuels.-Superviser l’activité quotidienne, définir les priorités et assurer la bonne répartition des missions
  • Collaborer étroitement avec la productrice afin de piloter les productions et d’assurer leur bon déroulement
  • Coordonner les équipes internes et les prestataires externes impliqués dans les shootings, la retouche et la livraison des images

 

Gestion budgétaire et pilotage des prestataires

  • Élaborer et piloter les budgets de production sur les périmètres e-commerce et showroom
  • Assurer le suivi des dépenses et veiller à la maîtrise des coûts
  • Identifier, sélectionner et coordonner les prestataires nécessaires aux productions
  • Gérer les relations avec les prestataires et suivre leurs prestations en fonction des besoins, des budgets et des exigences de qualité
  • Arbitrer les priorités de production en tenant compte des contraintes budgétaires, des plannings, des volumes à traiter et des impératifs de mise en ligne
 
 
 
 
VOTRE PROFIL
 
 
Expertise métier
  • Expérience confirmée en production photographique, idéalement dans les secteurs de la mode, du luxe ou du retail
  • Maîtrise de l’organisation et du pilotage de shootings photo à forts volumes
  • Bonne connaissance de l’art buying et des réseaux de prestataires créatifs et techniques
  • Maîtrise des processus de post-production, de retouche et de livraison des images
  • Compréhension des enjeux de production des assets e-commerce et des supports visuels showroom
  • Bonne connaissance des standards de contrôle qualité des images : gabarits, cadrages, formats, chromies et conformité des visuels
  • Utilisation de l’IA comme levier d’optimisation des processus de production et de post-production
 
Pilotage et management
  • Capacité à gérer plusieurs productions simultanément
  • Maîtrise de la gestion budgétaire, de la planification et du suivi des ressources
  • Capacité à prioriser les productions en fonction des calendriers de drops, des urgences de mise en ligne et des contraintes budgétaires
  • Expérience en management d’équipe et en coordination de prestataires
  • Capacité à structurer les flux de travail, à gérer les priorités et à anticiper les risques
  • Aptitude à résoudre les problématiques opérationnelles et à garantir le respect des engagements de livraison
 
 
Qualités personnelles
 
  • Organisation, rigueur et sens de l’anticipation
  • Sensibilité visuelle et exigence en matière de qualité
  • Leadership et capacité à fédérer des équipes
  • Réactivité et aptitude à gérer des environnements de production exigeants
  • Excellent sens de la coordination et de la communication
  • Capacité à arbitrer et à prendre des décisions dans un environnement soumis à des contraintes de délais, de volumes et de budgets

We want you as a highly talented Valve Test Engineer II, to help us advance our mission by leading cryogenic valve testing for our high-thrust engine. You will be the primary engineer responsible for defining, planning, executing, and closing valve development test campaigns.


Key responsibilities:

In your capacity as a cryogenic Valve Test Engineer II, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include:

  • Own the valve component-level development test execution for Storm

  • Translate engineering questions and requirements into test plans, matrices, procedures, and success criteria

  • Define test sequencing, configurations, instrumentation, data needs, and readiness criteria

  • Coordinate hardware, test bench, facility, calibration, safety, and operational preparation

  • Lead safety analysis and test readiness reviews and drive campaign execution through completion

  • Execute and oversee functional, pressure, flow, transient, environmental, endurance, and other campaign-specific tests

  • Analyse test data, assess anomalies, and distinguish hardware behaviour from test-system effects

  • Produce clear test reports with conclusions, limitations, recommendations, and requirement traceability

  • Drive root-cause investigations and use test evidence to guide design iterations and follow-on testing
