About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Legal Operations Specialist – Data Licensing on the IP & Licensing team, you will own the processes that let Mistral license content and data without slowing down. This role exists because we need someone who can turn legal analysis into repeatable workflows — managing rights, obligations, and restrictions across our growing dataset portfolio. You will work closely with the colleagues who negotiate our commercial and legal agreements, turning their work into clear metadata, tracked obligations, and automated systems.

Your impact will be visible in how smoothly data moves into our AI products: fewer bottlenecks, clearer rights status, and one reliable record for every data agreement we sign. You will sit where copyright, data protection, and AI meet, making sure that as we acquire and use training data, we comply with EU and US law, respect third-party rights, and enforce the restrictions our contracts impose. In scope: clearing permissions for inbound data, reviewing and codifying contracts, maintaining a central rights-and-obligations database, and building AI-powered workflows that make all of this scalable.

What You Will Do

  • Clear inbound data usage requests by researching rights status, scope, obligations, and restrictions — including anonymization and data protection requirements — before data enters our systems.

  • Review data-related agreements and codify their key terms into structured metadata, maintaining our template library and playbook alongside Legal.

  • Assess whether specific AI use cases fall within the scope of third-party agreements, flag gaps, and recommend contract amendments.

  • Build and maintain a central database that serves as the single source of truth for every signed data-related agreement.

  • Track and manage compliance with ongoing obligations — permitted uses, confidentiality, re-use rights — automate our reporting, and administer master licensing partnerships.

  • Verify provenance, ownership, and consent for acquired data, and identify obligations that require active monitoring.

  • Monitor that Mistral clients and partners stay within their granted rights, operating the approval system that enforces legal restrictions.

  • Design and run AI-powered workflows for contract review assistance, obligation extraction, and renewal alerts.

What We're Looking For

  • A bachelor's degree in law, publishing, information science, business, or a related field.

  • 2–5 years of experience in copyright, permissions, licensing, legal operations, or contract administration — ideally in an AI, tech, or data-driven environment.

  • Working knowledge of EU and US copyright law and contract administration, with demonstrated ability to interpret contracts independently.

  • Meticulous attention to detail and discretion with confidential contracts, combined with strong project-management skills.

  • Clear, direct communication and the initiative to anticipate needs through ambiguity.

  • A legal-ops mindset: you want to turn legal analysis into repeatable, scalable processes, not just handle one-off reviews.

  • Comfort building agentic AI workflows in a complex enterprise environment — you are an AI power user, ideally with experience setting up such workflows in a legal team.

  • Additional depth in formal legal training, CLM platforms (e.g., Ironclad), publishing-house contracts, or European languages (French, German, Spanish, etc.) is welcome.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

About Us

Base360.ai is the AI operating system for short-term rental businesses, helping property managers run their operations on autopilot.

Born out of The Flex, a short-term rental operator that scaled to an eight-figure business using its own software, Base360.ai is now launching as a standalone platform for short-term rental operators worldwide.

We bring reservations, guest communication, pricing, payments, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting into one platform—helping operators automate manual work, reduce costs, increase revenue, and scale their portfolios.

We're looking for an ambitious Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer who wants to turn real customer problems into intuitive, reliable software. You'll work closely with founders, designers, and operators to identify what matters, build solutions, and improve them based on how people use them.

If you enjoy owning the full journey from customer problem to shipped product—and you're excited by AI, automation, and short-term rentals—we want to meet you.

What You'll Build

As a Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer, you'll help shape and scale Base360.ai across the entire short-term rental lifecycle.

You'll build customer-facing features, operational dashboards, automation engines, AI-powered workflows, and integrations that help property managers grow without increasing their workload at the same rate.

Your work will connect what users see with the systems behind it—from a guest’s check-in experience to the workflows coordinating reservations, cleaning, payments, and owner reporting.

Your Mission

Understand Customer Problems

Work directly with property managers and internal teams to understand their workflows, identify friction, and decide which problems are worth solving.

Build Products End-to-End

Take features from idea and prototype through frontend, backend, integrations, testing, and deployment. Own the complete experience and how it performs in production.

Create Intuitive User Experiences

Work with designers to make complex short-term rental operations easy to manage. Build interfaces that help users complete tasks quickly and confidently.

Create Powerful Automations

Build event-driven workflows that eliminate repetitive work—from scheduling cleaning after a booking to sending check-in instructions and generating owner statements.

Develop AI-Powered Features

Use LLMs and AI agents to automate guest communication, triage maintenance requests, support pricing decisions, and help operators manage their portfolios more efficiently.

Connect the Ecosystem

Build reliable APIs and integrations with platforms including Airbnb, Hostaway, Stripe, Twilio, OpenAI, Google, and other partners across the short-term rental ecosystem.

Solve Real Operational Problems

Build solutions for:

  • Real-time reservation and availability synchronization

  • Dynamic pricing intelligence

  • Smart lock access and key management

  • Automated guest communication across channels

  • Guest check-in and upsell journeys

  • Operational forecasting

  • Cleaning and maintenance automation

  • Owner reporting and financial workflows

  • AI-powered monitoring and alerts

Measure and Improve

Use customer feedback, product usage, and operational results to evaluate what you ship. Improve features based on adoption, time saved, fewer errors, and better user outcomes.

Build for Scale

Make sound technical decisions that balance delivery speed, maintainability, security, and reliability as more operators and properties join the platform.

Tech Stack

We care more about capability than specific technologies, but our current stack includes:

  • Python

  • FastAPI

  • React

  • TypeScript

  • Supabase

  • PostgreSQL

  • AWS

  • Serverless architecture

  • OpenAI APIs

  • Twilio

  • Stripe

  • Docker

  • GitHub Actions

You Might Be a Great Fit If You Have

  • Strong experience building and shipping production software

  • The ability to work across frontend and backend systems

  • Experience with React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, or similar technologies

  • Strong understanding of APIs, databases, integrations, and cloud architecture

  • A product mindset and curiosity about why users need a feature

  • Good judgment around usability, scope, and technical trade-offs

  • The ability to turn an ambiguous problem into a practical, working solution

  • Confidence working directly with customers, designers, and founders

  • The ability to work independently and own outcomes

  • Curiosity about AI, automation, and operational efficiency

  • A bias toward shipping, learning, and iterating

Bonus points for experience with:

  • Short-term rentals, hospitality technology, or property management systems

  • Multi-tenant SaaS platforms

  • Marketplace businesses and booking channel integrations

  • AI agents and workflow automation

  • Product analytics and experimentation

  • Event-driven architectures

  • Supabase

  • AWS serverless infrastructure

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 12 months:

  • You've shipped features that property managers actively use

  • Core short-term rental workflows are automated through products you've built

  • Customers spend less time on manual administration and repetitive tasks

  • Complex workflows become easier to understand and complete

  • Integrations move reservations, availability, payments, and operational data reliably

  • AI-powered features become part of customers’ everyday operations

  • Customer feedback and usage data consistently inform your product decisions

  • Your work helps operators grow their portfolios, improve guest experiences, and operate more profitably

Why Join Us

Build Something Meaningful

Solve problems experienced daily by short-term rental operators, with direct access to The Flex’s operations to test ideas and see their impact.

Own the Product Outcome

Help decide what to build, how it should work, and how to measure its success. Take responsibility for features from the first conversation through ongoing improvement.

Small Team, Massive Opportunity

Work closely with the founders and directly influence the product and technical direction of Base360.ai.

Learn Faster

Solve real-world challenges across product, software, AI, automation, hospitality operations, and scale.

Performance-Based Rewards

Competitive compensation with substantial upside for exceptional performers.

Remote-First

Work from anywhere. We care about outcomes, not hours.

This Role Is Not For You If

  • You're looking for a slow-paced corporate environment

  • You want a narrowly defined role with limited customer or product involvement

  • You need detailed specifications before you can make progress

Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

About the role:
As a Senior Software Developer at Checkout.com, you will be embedded within the Identity Verification Team, a critical function focused on building innovative products to verify the identities of individuals and businesses globally.
In this high-impact role, you will be instrumental in the development of next-generation verification features, deploying intelligent, production-ready solutions by leveraging state-of-the-art Orchestration technologies as well as Generative AI and Computer Vision technologies.
You will be expected to work closely and collaboratively with Product, DevOps, DataScientist, and Data teams to ensure successful, end-to-end delivery of these solutions, while constantly researching and integrating emerging technologies. A core part of your contribution will be safeguarding data integrity and ensuring compliance, and translating complex data insights into clear, actionable recommendations for stakeholders to support informed, data-driven decision-making across Checkout.com.

What you will be doing:
• Drive the design and development of innovative, complex and scalable applications for real-world identity verification challenges in a wider microservices using industry best practices.
• Take full ownership of new and existing features and service, managing the end-to-end lifecycle from initial conceptualization and design through to deployment and monitoring in a production environment.
• Actively collaborate with cross-functional teams (Engineering, Product, Risk) across the company to maximize the positive impact of data science initiatives.
• Champion a culture of technical excellence, cross-team learning, and knowledge sharing within the Data organization.
• Be part of, and collaborate with, cross-functional teams including product management, across a large engineering community.
• Write clean, maintainable, extendable and testable code on some of Checkout’s most impactful systems.
• Build, own and operate your systems to the highest levels of resilience and service.
• Mentor junior team members and assist in their technical development

What are we looking for:

ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :

École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.

Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.

IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.

IMT Mines Albi, au travers du Centre Génie Industriel (CGI), développe des recherches à la frontière entre l’intelligence artificielle et le génie industriel, en collaboration avec des partenaires publics et industriels nationaux et internationaux.

Le Centre Génie Industriel (CGI) (https://cgi.imt-mines-albi.fr/) compte environ 70 personnes dont 25 doctorants. Le centre s’intéresse à l’accompagnement de la transition des écosystèmes en permettant de prendre des décisions responsables et durables, dans des environnements instables ou perturbés. Ceci est mis en pratique par la représentation, la modélisation et l’analyse des données de ces organisations afin de formaliser de la connaissance conduisant à la prise de décision dans des contextes hétérogènes, collaboratifs, incertains et/ou perturbés.

Le CGI est structuré selon des axes de recherche appliquée et des programmes scientifiques. Les axes de recherche appliquée sont :

  • Axe FLOWS : Flexible Logistics and Operations for sustainable WorldS dans lequel ce poste est rattaché.

  • Axe DiSCS : Digital Systems for Crisis management and Security ;

  • Axe TRACE : Territorial Resilience, Agility, and Circular Economy ;

  • Axe WHOPS : Well-being and Health through Organizational Processes and Services.

Les deux programmes scientifiques au cœur de ces axes de recherche sont :

  • HOPOPOP : Hybridization for Operations & Planning, Organizations & Performance, Optimization & Problem-solving ; 

  • AIME-DM : Automated Information Modeling and Extraction for Decision-Makers.

 

DESCRIPTION DU POSTE :

Dans le contexte de l’Education 4.0, les différents acteurs d’un établissement de formation universitaire (étudiants, personnels, intervenants extérieurs, etc.) ont des contraintes et des objectifs différents ce qui rend complexe la coordination et le pilotage de tels établissements (organisation et planification des enseignements, gestion des espaces collectifs, organisation des sessions d’examens…).

En complément, ces établissements doivent s’adapter tant sur la gestion de leurs sites (meilleure adéquation à de nouvelles formes pédagogiques) que sur les flux de personnes les utilisant pour une meilleure répartition des charges et une interopérabilité de tous les outils à disposition (par exemple, un gestionnaire d’emploi du temps). Dans ce cadre, le jumeau numérique organisationnel représente le système qui permet une simulation et une aide à la prise de décision par des échanges bidirectionnels entre l’organisation physique (personnes et systèmes dont les bâtiments) et sa réplique virtuelle dans un objectif de pilotage global des flux.

Le projet DIGIFAC’Santé s’inscrit dans ce contexte. Il porte sur la conception et le développement d'un jumeau numérique des sites d’une université, de la gestion des flux étudiants et personnels et de l’évolution pédagogique de ses formations.

Un jumeau numérique ne peut remplir son rôle qu'à la condition de représenter fidèlement les informations essentielles à la prise de décision, elles-mêmes issues de données collectées dans les différents services de l’Université et des applications logicielles actuelles. Or, ces applications présentent des niveaux d’hétérogénéité différents selon leurs fonctionnalités. La nature des opérations réalisées (emploi du temps, gestion des salles et du matériel, etc.) impose des contraintes fortes sur la disponibilité de ces données : leur collecte automatique et en temps réel n'est pas toujours techniquement envisageable, ce qui constitue un défi central pour l'alimentation du jumeau numérique.

L’étude à mener dans le cadre de ce projet vise à :

Modéliser le besoin informationnel. Il s'agit de concevoir un méta-modèle capable de représenter, de façon générique et formelle, les informations strictement nécessaires à l’alimentation du jumeau numérique universitaire. Ce méta-modèle doit permettre de cadrer la remontée d'information en définissant le juste besoin, c'est-à-dire en distinguant ce qui relève de l'information décisionnelle de ce qui constitue un artefact de collecte sans valeur ajoutée pour le pilotage.

Alimenter les modèles. Une fois le méta-modèle du besoin informationnel établi, la question de son instanciation à partir de données réelles des applications existantes se pose. Comment alimenter ces modèles à partir de données hétérogènes, partielles, et produites selon des rythmes et des modalités de collecte variables ? Ceci articule des enjeux d'intégration, de qualité et de cohérence de la donnée au regard des exigences du jumeau numérique.

Gérer l'absence de certaines données. Dans un contexte où certaines opérations ne permettent pas une collecte automatique et en temps réel, en raison de la nature même des processus mis en place (par exemple, construction de l’emploi du temps, suivi des cohortes d’étudiants), comment maintenir la cohérence et la complétude de la représentation portée par le jumeau numérique ? Ce lot interroge la capacité du système à pallier les lacunes de la remontée de données par des mécanismes d'inférence ou de déduction, permettant de reconstituer un état vraisemblable du système à partir d'informations partielles.

Proposer des aides au dimensionnement et au pilotage des sites universitaires. Il s’agit ici d’utiliser le jumeau numérique dans toutes ses fonctionnalités afin entres autres de s’assurer que les évolutions bâtimentaires envisagées permettent d’accueillir l’ensemble des flux actuel et projeté pour cet établissement, de permettre d’optimiser les flux entre les différents sites et de valider les choix d’évolution des pratiques pédagogiques et leur adéquation vis à vis des capacités disponibles (salles et équipements spécifiques, surfaces, personnels,etc.).

Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables :

  • Modélisation des processus / d’organisation

  • Analyse systémique

  • Analyse de données

  • Ingénierie dirigée par les modèles

  • Aide à la décision

  • Simulation à évènements discrets et jumeau numérique

  • Fouille de processus (process mining),

  • Des connaissances en algorithmique, UML, Web sémantique seront très appréciées

Capacités et aptitudes :

  • Anglais écrit et parlé (Niveau B2 minimum exigé) ; cf. référentiel européen ; ex. :  785/990 minimum au TOEIC), attesté par une certification reconnue (TOEFL, TOEIC, IELTS).

  • La maîtrise du français (C1 minimum) est exigée afin de faciliter les échanges avec les experts et les acteurs.

  • Capacité à travailler dans une équipe de recherche, autonomie, esprit d’initiative, organisation, curiosité intellectuelle…

  • Motivation pour contribuer à une application universitaire

 

PROFIL RECHERCHE :

Ingénieur.e recherche ou post-doctorant, en génie industriel et/ou supply chain management et/ou Génie Logiciel ou Master ou équivalent (niveau Bac+5).

 

AU-DELÀ DE L’ENVIRONNEMENT PROFESSIONNEL, POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? :

  • cadre de travail agréable dans un campus de 22 ha

  • 49 jours de congés par an

  • restauration administrative sur place

  • aide à la mobilité durable pour le transport domicile-travail

  • action sociale (protection sociale complémentaire et aide aux familles)

 

INFORMATIONS COMPLÉMENTAIRES :

Le poste est basé à IMT Mines Albi, Centre Génie Industriel, Albi (France). Des déplacements sont à prévoir sur le site du partenaire du projet à Toulouse (Haute Garonne), France.

 

  • Nature et durée du contrat : CDD 12 mois

 

À usage interne :

  • Catégorie du poste et métier de référence :  Catégorie II, Métier R – Ingénieur de recherche

  • Métier(s) de référence des agents pouvant postuler : Toutes catégories

  • Localisation du poste : IMT Mines Albi, Campus Jarlard, Route de Teillet 81013 ALBI CT Cedex 09

  • Date limite de candidature : 22/11/2026

  • Date de prise de fonction souhaitée : 01/01/2027

  • La rémunération est fixée selon le profil du candidat (métier, âge, filière d'emploi, durée de garantie salariale), en fonction des règles définies par le cadre de gestion de l'Institut Mines Télécom

  • Emploi ouvert aux titulaires de catégorie A de la fonction publique et/ou aux personnes contractuelles

Head of DC Operations (H/F)

Région parisienne

Votre mission

Dans un environnement où la disponibilité et la fiabilité des infrastructures sont essentielles, Isatalent recherche un(e) Head of DC Operations pour piloter les opérations de ses data centers en région parisienne.

Rattaché(e) à la direction, vous êtes garant(e) de la performance opérationnelle, de la continuité de service et de la fiabilité des infrastructures. Vous encadrez les responsables de site et travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'expertise centrales, les clients et les partenaires de maintenance.

Dans un contexte de croissance de l'entreprise et d'exigences opérationnelles, vous jouez un rôle clé dans l'harmonisation des pratiques, la structuration du pilotage des activités et l'accompagnement du changement auprès des équipes.

Votre objectif : construire une vision opérationnelle consolidée, maîtriser les risques et fédérer les équipes autour d'exigences communes de performance, de sécurité et de qualité de service.

Vos responsabilités

Piloter la stratégie et la performance des opérations multisites

  • Élaborer une feuille de route opérationnelle à court et moyen terme, en définissant les priorités, les plans d'action et les ressources humaines et financières nécessaires.

  • Définir et harmoniser les méthodes de pilotage des activités opérationnelles sur l'ensemble des sites.

  • Consolider et faire évoluer les KPI et tableaux de bord portant notamment sur la disponibilité des infrastructures, la maintenance, la communication client et le respect des procédures.

  • Analyser les résultats, identifier les écarts de performance et piloter les actions correctives.

  • Produire un reporting structuré à destination de la direction et éclairer les décisions stratégiques.

Manager les responsables de site et accompagner la transformation

  • Encadrer et accompagner les responsables de site dans le pilotage de leurs activités et le développement de leurs compétences.

  • Apporter une expertise opérationnelle et technique permettant de challenger les choix, les priorités et les plans d'action.

  • Favoriser l'autonomie, la responsabilisation et la coopération des équipes.

  • Organiser l'allocation des ressources et le suivi des plans de charge.

  • Accompagner la réorganisation du périmètre, harmoniser les pratiques et contribuer à l'intégration de nouveaux sites.

  • Travailler en transversalité avec le responsable du pôle Expertise et les autres fonctions de l'entreprise.

Garantir la fiabilité des infrastructures et maîtriser les risques

  • Garantir la disponibilité, la résilience et la continuité d'exploitation des infrastructures critiques.

  • Superviser la maintenance préventive, corrective et réglementaire, ainsi que les travaux, extensions, rétrofits et changements réalisés en environnement exploité.

  • Reprendre et consolider la cartographie des risques opérationnels et techniques, notamment les points uniques de défaillance (SPOF) et les obsolescences critiques.

  • Hiérarchiser les risques, définir les plans de traitement, en évaluer les impacts financiers et humains et identifier les investissements nécessaires.

  • Piloter les incidents majeurs, les escalades, les analyses de causes et le suivi des actions correctives et préventives.

  • Garantir le respect des exigences de sécurité, de conformité et de continuité de service.

Développer la relation client et le partenariat avec les mainteneurs

  • Garantir le respect des engagements contractuels, des SLA et des standards de qualité attendus par les clients.

  • Renforcer la qualité de la communication opérationnelle et la confiance avec les interlocuteurs clients.

  • Développer une relation constructive et partenariale avec les mainteneurs et les prestataires.

  • Améliorer la coordination des interventions, le suivi des engagements et la qualité des prestations.

  • Identifier les axes de progrès et piloter les actions d'amélioration de la performance des partenaires.

Piloter les budgets et l'amélioration continue

  • Élaborer et suivre les budgets OPEX et CAPEX du périmètre.

  • Arbitrer les priorités de maintenance, de renouvellement et d'investissement en fonction des risques, des capacités et des engagements clients.

  • Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires, environnementales, HSE, ICPE et des référentiels ISO applicables.

  • Déployer des standards, procédures et méthodes de travail homogènes.

  • Contribuer à l'amélioration de la performance énergétique des installations, notamment du PUE, et à la maîtrise des coûts d'exploitation.

Votre profil

Formation et expérience

  • Formation supérieure, idéalement Bac +5, de type ingénieur ou master spécialisé en génie électrique, énergétique, climatique, maintenance industrielle ou management des opérations. Un Bac +3 technique pourra être étudié au regard d'une expérience particulièrement solide.

  • Expérience significative dans l'exploitation, la maintenance ou la direction technique d'infrastructures critiques.

  • Expérience significative en management de managers, en pilotage multisite ou dans une fonction de responsabilité opérationnelle comparable.

  • Expérience confirmée dans un environnement critique fonctionnant 24h/24 et 7j/7, avec de fortes exigences de disponibilité, de sécurité et de conformité.

  • Expérience en gestion d'incidents majeurs, pilotage de budgets, gestion des risques et conduite de transformations opérationnelles.

Compétences techniques

  • Bonne maîtrise des enjeux d'exploitation des data centers et compréhension des architectures électriques, mécaniques, CVC, de protection incendie, de GTB/BMS et des systèmes de contrôle.

  • Maîtrise du pilotage de la maintenance préventive, corrective et réglementaire.

  • Connaissance des SLA, KPI de disponibilité, capacité, qualité de service et performance énergétique.

  • Capacité à analyser et challenger les risques techniques, les plans de maintenance et les investissements.

  • Maîtrise des enjeux budgétaires OPEX/CAPEX et des exigences réglementaires applicables.

Qualités personnelles

  • Leadership et capacité à manager des responsables expérimentés.

  • Crédibilité technique et sens des responsabilités.

  • Capacité à structurer une organisation, harmoniser les pratiques et conduire le changement.

  • Aptitude à fédérer les équipes et à développer la coopération transverse.

  • Capacité de décision, d'arbitrage et de priorisation.

  • Sang-froid en situation de crise, rigueur et orientation résultats.

  • Sens du client et capacité à construire des relations de partenariat durables.

Langues : français courant et anglais professionnel, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.

Les enjeux de réussite

Au cours des premiers mois, vous aurez notamment pour objectifs de construire une feuille de route opérationnelle claire, de consolider le pilotage par les indicateurs, de hiérarchiser les risques et de définir les moyens nécessaires à leur traitement.

Vous contribuerez également à renforcer la cohésion managériale, à harmoniser les pratiques entre les sites et à accompagner l'évolution de l'organisation dans une logique durable de performance et d'amélioration continue.

Vous souhaitez mettre votre expertise des infrastructures critiques au service d'un environnement exigeant, avec une forte dimension managériale, stratégique et transverse ?

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il si important chez nous ?

Avec 900 000 clients en janvier 2026 (x3 en 2025), Pennylane évolue dans un contexte d'hyper croissance.

L'équipe commerciale joue un rôle primordial dans la recherche et la signature de nouveaux contrats.

Dans ce contexte, l’équipe AE Small Business gère des prospects provenant essentiellement du site web, ayant commencé le funnel self-signup, mais n’ayant pas réussi/terminé la souscription.
A partir d'informations qualitatives, leur objectif est de les signer (en partie en direct par appel) pour générer du MRR. Le volume actuel géré est de 2 500 leads par mois.

Contexte 2026

L’équipe Account Executive Small Business grandit vite et se structure.

Il va y avoir une augmentation du volume à gérer, des process à mettre en place, en parallèle d’un besoin de coaching important (équipe presque entièrement renouvelée, avec des profils relativement juniors sur la partie closing).

L'équipe grandit vite et atteint désormais 10 personnes. Pour continuer à scaler sans sacrifier la qualité du management et du coaching, nous avons besoin d'un·e Team Lead AE Small Business qui prendra en charge 5 SBS en direct, permettant à Thomas de se concentrer sur les 5 autres membres, la stratégie, et la coordination globale de l'équipe.

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

En tant que Team Lead Account Executive Small Business, tu assureras un rôle de management d'une équipe d’AE full-cycle sur le segment des petites entreprises (0-5 salariés). Tu seras garant·e de la performance de ton pod de 5 AEs, de leur montée en compétences et de l'atteinte des objectifs MRR collectifs.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

Management d'équipe

  • Piloter et développer un pod de 5 AE Small

    • Animer les rituels d'équipe (1:1 hebdomadaires, weekly, revues de pipe, points de synchro)

    • Former et coacher les SBS sur la méthodologie, la qualification et le closing

    • Définir et suivre les objectifs individuels et contribuer aux objectifs collectifs

    • Gérer les écarts de performance et mettre en place des plans d'accompagnement ciblés

    • Garantir l'éthique/culture de travail, le bien-être et la rétention de l'équipe

  • Pilotage de la performance

    • Suivre les KPIs clés : volume d’activité, MRR signé, taux de conversion, nombre de deals closés, vitesse de traitement des leads - et garantir leur atteinte

    • Analyser les données de son pod via Salesforce/Metabase et identifier les leviers d'amélioration

    • Remonter les insights terrain et proposer des actions correctives

    • Participer à l'effort de vente en prenant part aux appels avec l'équipe

  • Structuration & amélioration continue

    • Contribuer à l'amélioration continue du contacting et du discours commercial

    • Tester de nouvelles approches et partager les bonnes pratiques avec l'ensemble de l'équipe

    • Aider à la mise en place et au respect de la sales policy

    • Collaborer avec les équipes SDR, Marketing, Ops & Data pour fluidifier la transmission des leads (leur qualité, conversion), et optimiser le fonctionnement du département

  • Être un relais terrain

    • Faire remonter les feedbacks produit et commerciaux aux équipes internes

    • Être l'interface entre son pod et les équipes transverses (Care, Onboarding, Ops)

Profil recherché

Compétences techniques

  • Expérience commerciale confirmée :

    • 3+ ans de closing B2B (ou B2C),

    • Idéalement dans un contexte de volume élevé, cycle court et full-cycle

  • Track record MRR/closing : Capacité prouvée à atteindre et dépasser des objectifs de revenus récurrents

  • Expérience en management : 1+ an de management d'équipe ou expérience TL/mentor (idéalement 3-5 personnes) — une forte expérience opérationnelle et de mentoring peut compenser une expérience sans management

  • Data-driven : À l'aise avec les outils CRM (Salesforce), analytics (Metabase) et la gestion par les KPIs

  • Connaissance du secteur : Une appétence pour le secteur comptable, fintech ou SaaS est un atout

Compétences relationnelles

  • Leadership naturel : Capacité à entraîner une équipe, à donner du feedback direct et constructif

  • Coach : Capacité à analyser la performance, construire et suivre des plans d’actions/coaching

  • Excellence commerciale : Aisance téléphonique, écoute active, capacité à closer rapidement dans un contexte "low touch"

  • Rigueur et organisation : Gestion simultanée de projets multiples et du management de 5 personnes

  • Esprit collaboratif : Capacité à travailler avec des équipes transverses

  • Adaptabilité : À l'aise dans un environnement scale-up en forte croissance

  • Orientation résultats : Ambition et envie de dépasser les objectifs individuels et collectifs

  • Pédagogie : Envie de former, de transmettre et de faire grandir son équipe

data.description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Are our Engineering principles aligned with your vision?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 900,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission

While some companies count on marketing and sales to gain market share, we are a product-led company and we are investing primarily on building an innovative and scalable platform. Tech teams have a crucial role to play to achieve this goal.

 

👪 Team and context

You’ll work within a DevOps team currently composed of 4 engineers, reporting to the Engineering Manager.

 

You’ll collaborate closely with 300+ engineers to define and elevate performance, reliability and observability standards across the organization.

 

You’ll be embedded in multidisciplinary product teams (Frontend & Backend), working closely with another DevOps Engineer and an Application Security Engineer.

 

This is a high-impact role : you’re joining early and will help shape how reliability works at scale.

 

🏠 Offices

The company's HQ are in Paris, but the whole Tech team is remote-first. You are thus free to work from wherever you want in Europe.

 

🎯 Your Missions

 

  • Evangelize and simplify SRE practices across our engineering organization (300+ engineers).

  • Proactively identify reliability and performance improvement opportunities - not just react to incidents.

  • Define and evolve performance, metrics and observability standards (SLIs/SLOs, monitoring frameworks, alerting strategies).

  • Scale production resources efficiently while ensuring resilience and cost awareness.

  • Design, implement and continuously improve tooling and monitoring systems.

  • Contribute to engineering guidelines and best practices around reliability and production excellence.

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Backend, Security and Platform stakeholders to embed reliability by design.

 

🥇 You're the right candidate if you have experience :

  • Working with cloud environments (we use AWS).

  • Building and evolving observability and monitoring systems (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Splunk or similar).

  • Scaling production systems and web applications, including asynchronous job systems.

  • Operating in high-growth or product-led environments.

  • Influencing engineering teams and driving reliability practices at scale.

 
 

What do we do to make your work life easier

 

🏢 You'll be able to work remotely from anywhere in Europe, as long as your contract allows you to

💵 You’ll have a compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your english or your french

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🎉 You’ll be part of a vibrant social community : we do lots of sports together (Foot, running, climbing...), we love to hang out and have a drink together (thursday afterwork drinks on our rooftop is a usual thing. Twice-a-year we do company seminars, last time we went on a trip to Centerparcs and it was fabulous !)

 

And.. If you're based in France :

 

🏢 You’ll be able to work fully from your home or any co-working space in France, or from our wonderful office in the center of Paris

🏝You’ll get between 8 to 13 additional days off (to the 25 standard ones) to rest and do what you love each year

🍜 You’ll have lunch credits (Swile card) to buy your favorite food every day

🏥 You’ll have a great healthcare cover (Alan Blue) to take care of yourself and your family

 

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

This is a hands-on role for someone who can execute fast, iterate with creative and funnel inputs, and scale what works. You’ll inherit high-performing campaigns and work directly with our CMO to double down on growth.

You’ll then also have the opportunity to test and scale new channels (TikTok, Meta, Snapchat, Native, ASA) depending on performance and market constraints.

Your Responsibilities

Campaign Ownership and Scaling

  • Take the lead on one or two paid acquisition channels (e.g., Meta, TikTok, Google, etc.), with potential to expand scope based on performance

  • Contribute to building scalable acquisition funnels, from execution to iteration, with aggressive growth targets in mind

  • Run high-velocity testing loops (creatives, audiences, placements) to improve CAC and LTV

Performance Analysis and Strategy

  • Monitor performance daily using tools like Voluum, GA4, and internal dashboards

  • Drive decision-making through deep analysis of CPA, ROAS, retention, and cohort behavior

  • Build and maintain internal reporting frameworks that guide strategic shifts and tactical moves

Creative & Funnel Optimization

  • Own the creative briefing process: define hooks, formats, and angles based on performance patterns

  • Collaborate closely with the content and product teams to launch and iterate on high-converting landing pages

  • Implement systems to reduce creative fatigue and increase speed of testing

Partnership Management & Media Strategy

  • Build strong relationships with traffic sources and negotiate premium placements and custom deals

  • Explore new acquisition opportunities (networks, formats, tools) and build internal evaluation criteria

  • Stay ahead of ecosystem changes (platform rules, algorithm shifts) and adapt strategy accordingly

Automation & Scaling Systems

  • Identify opportunities to streamline acquisition processes through automation and internal tools

  • Create SOPs, playbooks, and experiment pipelines for scaling campaigns efficiently

Challenges You’ll Tackle

  • Scale existing campaigns to 3x+ budget while maintaining CAC/ROAS goals

  • Contribute to growing the user base from 30M to 100M users in the next 12 months

  • Execute 0-to-1 testing in new channels

  • Improve conversion through landing page testing and funnel iteration

  • Own both creative input and analytical feedback loops

Your Qualifications

Hard Skills

Must-Haves

  • 4–10+ years in performance marketing or user acquisition

  • Proven track record managing $300K to $1M+/month in paid media spend

  • Full ownership of campaign execution, results, and optimization

  • Experience with Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, ASA, or native platforms

  • Analytical fluency: GA4, Voluum, tracking setups, dashboards

  • Strong creative instincts: can write briefs, analyze hooks, and iterate fast

  • Experience optimizing landing pages and funnel conversion

Nice‑to‑Haves

  • Past exposure to subscription models and CAC/LTV frameworks

  • Experience in sensitive or regulated verticals (e.g. dating, femtech, telehealth)

Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English)

🎯 Goal-oriented, ownership and commitment

⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and need people who can balance execution, planning, and strategy

⏱️ Obsessive about speed, performance and iteration

🧢 Humble - willing to learn, open to feedback

🍭 #NSFW - Comfortable advertising products based on uncensored models and content

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

Compensation: €65K – €105K • Offers Bonus

data.title: Senior Performance Marketer (Full Remote - France)

data.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Senior Revenue Operations job

Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership.

You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team, whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost.

Why is this role interesting?

  • High-impact scope: You'll work across the full sales organization, from Account Executives to BDRs, Account Management, and Customer Success Managers.

  • Real ownership: You'll own initiatives end to end, from strategy and design to execution and adoption, not just delivery.

  • Builder's playground: You'll have access to a modern stack, combining low-code tools, AI (Dust, Claude), Salesforce, and SQL, to ship things fast and at scale.

  • Tangible results: Recent examples from our roadmap include fully automating slide deck generation for Sales (saving 1,000+ hours per year) and building an AI-powered outbound machine reaching a 15% discovery rate.

What will you do with us?

You'll own effectiveness initiatives end to end, setting the roadmap, designing the solution, building it, driving execution, and managing change across the organization. You'll spend meaningful time in the field to spot gaps in our sales process, then design smarter workflows by eliminating steps and increasing automation. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works.

You'll mostly work with low-code tools (like Zapier or n8n), AI, Salesforce, SQL via Metabase, and whatever else the job calls for. Enablement is a key part of the role: you'll shadow, train, measure adoption, and iterate until change sticks.

 

⭐ Is it you we're looking for?

You'll be a great fit for the Revenue Operations team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 5 years of experience in RevOps / Sales Ops / Sales Effectiveness, several of them spent hands-on building the sales machine. You own initiatives end-to-end (scope, design, build, measure);

  • Demonstrate strong ownership and project management skills, and are comfortable running initiatives;

  • Have a builder mindset and love being hands-on;

  • Are confident with change management, including shadowing, training, measuring adoption, and iterating;

  • Can write and own SQL queries yourself (joins, basic data modeling), not just read them.

  • Have proven experience with low-code tools and integrations (e.g. Clay, Make, Zapier, or equivalent) to build scalable workflows

  • Have configured Salesforce yourself (objects, fields, flows) and can say what you personally built vs. what an integrator or another team did.

  • Are able to build and maintain pipelines that produce actionable insights, with clear business impact

  • Have excellent verbal and written communication skills;

  • Have at least an advanced level in English.

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

For this role we are looking to hire within the C1-E level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

#LI-DNP

Lemonway est un établissement de paiement agréé, au cœur de la nouvelle économie européenne.

Nous sécurisons les paiements des plateformes de financement participatif, d’économie collaborative, des marketplaces et des e-commerçants, avec un fort engagement contre la fraude et pour la protection des fonds.

Réglementée par l’ACPR et bénéficiant du passeport européen dans 29 pays, Lemonway est basée à Paris et Hambourg et rassemble 150 Lemonheroes multiculturels et engagés.

Plus de 400 marketplaces nous font confiance. Nous gérons 1,4 million de portefeuilles utilisateurs et avons levé 50 M€ auprès de Breega, SpeedInvest et Toscafund.

Rentable depuis quatre ans et en croissance de +25 % en 2025, Lemonway vise à rester parmi les leaders du paiement en Europe grâce à une croissance saine et durable.

  • Secteur : FinTech / Paiements en ligne

  • Localisation : Paris, France (Quartier du Sentier, 2e arrondissement)

  • Télétravail : Jusqu'à 2 jours par semaine (au choix)


Le rôle

Au sein de notre équipe Alternative Finance Sales, vous contribuerez à renforcer l’efficacité des activités commerciales, de la préparation des campagnes de prospection à la structuration des données et des outils Sales.

Ce stage vous permettra de jouer un rôle actif dans le développement commercial de Lemonway, en participant à l’identification de nouvelles opportunités, au mapping de comptes stratégiques et à la préparation de campagnes de prospection ciblées.

Vous découvrirez progressivement l’ensemble du cycle de vente, avec l’opportunité de participer aux rendez-vous commerciaux et de contribuer concrètement aux différentes étapes du développement de nos activités.

Vos missions

  • Rechercher et cartographier des comptes stratégiques, leurs activités et leurs décideurs.

  • Participer à la préparation de campagnes de prospection ciblées.

  • Contribuer à la rédaction de messages et de séquences d’e-mails.

  • Mettre à jour et fiabiliser les données dans Salesforce.

  • Réaliser des recherches de marché et une veille concurrentielle sur les paiements et la FinTech.

  • Identifier des opportunités d’automatisation et contribuer à la création d’outils utilisant l’intelligence artificielle.

  • Préparer des supports commerciaux et participer ponctuellement à des rendez-vous.

Ce que vous apprendrez

  • Les fondamentaux du Business Development et de la prospection B2B.

  • Les méthodes de recherche, de mapping et d’analyse de comptes.

  • La construction de campagnes commerciales ciblées.

  • L’utilisation d’un CRM et d’outils de prospection.

  • Les enjeux du marché des paiements et de la finance alternative.

  • Les applications concrètes de l’automatisation et de l’intelligence artificielle dans les activités commerciales.


Vous êtes en dernière année d’école de commerce, d’université ou d’une formation en commerce, marketing, finance, stratégie, data ou technologie, et vous recherchez un stage de fin d’études.

Nous recherchons avant tout une personne :

  • Curieuse, volontaire et désireuse d’apprendre.

  • Intéressée par la vente B2B, la FinTech, les paiements et les nouvelles technologies.

  • À l’aise avec la recherche d’informations, l’analyse et la structuration de données.

  • Rigoureuse, organisée et attentive à la qualité des informations collectées.

  • Autonome, impliquée et capable de gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle.

  • Dotée d’un bon esprit d’équipe et d’une réelle envie de contribuer.

Une appétence pour les outils et les environnements techniques sera un réel atout. Une première expérience avec un CRM, des outils de prospection ou de data enrichment, des solutions d’automatisation, du scraping, des outils no-code, de l’analyse de données ou de l’intelligence artificielle sera particulièrement appréciée. La maîtrise de ces outils n’est toutefois pas indispensable.

La maîtrise professionnelle complète du français et de l’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, est indispensable. La maîtrise de l’espagnol constitue un atout important.

Le processus de recrutement

  1. Entretien d’introduction avec Sabina, Talent Acquisition Manager

Les entretiens permettront notamment d’évaluer votre curiosité, votre capacité d’apprentissage, votre rigueur, vos compétences relationnelles et votre adéquation avec les missions du stage.

We are looking for someone to join us as an early member of the Web team, to build and own web platforms that turn large amounts of data into products people love to use. Maps and location data sit at the core of what we build, and we’re looking for an engineer who can take a platform from data model to pixel.

In the initial months, you’ll work closely with the team, gradually taking ownership of central systems and features. Given our stage, we’re seeking versatile engineers comfortable contributing across the frontend, the backend and the data.

We value team members who delve deep into their respective domains, aiming to cultivate a team of subject matter experts with a high sense of ownership. This commitment to expertise is an expectation for every team member.

As a Web Engineer, your day-to-day will include:

Platform Engineering

Designing and building robust, scalable web platforms end-to-end in TypeScript: APIs, services, data access layers and the UI on top of them. You’ll make the architectural decisions and set the patterns that others build on.

Workflows & Data Pipelines

Architecting durable, long-running workflows and background processes on our workflow orchestration system (Restate). You’ll also build the pipelines that move data between our warehouse, our databases and our products, reliably and at scale.

Data Modeling & Visualization

Modeling large datasets so they can be queried and visualized fast. That includes choosing the right aggregations, pre-computations and storage across Postgres and BigQuery, and turning them into visualizations that are clear, interactive and beautiful. You’ll handle data with privacy in mind from the very first design decision.

Maps & Geospatial Data

Bringing geospatial data to life on the web. You’ll render large amounts of location data on interactive maps, and keep them as fast and polished as they are insightful.

Roadmap Creation and Ideation

Contributing actively to the roadmap: identifying the right tradeoffs and bringing ideas from both a product and an engineering perspective.

Owning your scope

You’ll be responsible for the architecture, performance, monitoring and reliability of everything you ship. We value engineers who take full ownership of their scope, and who proactively address issues before anyone asks.


Your Skills & Experience:

Please indicate your years of experience on the application form.

  • 7+ years of professional experience building SaaS products or data-heavy platforms.

  • High proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js, and in modern web frameworks (React, Next.js…).

  • Strong experience with Postgres and data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar).

  • Solid understanding of data modeling for analytics and for visualizing large volumes of data.

  • A privacy-aware approach to handling sensitive data, such as aggregation and anonymization.

  • Comfortable working autonomously across frontend and backend.

  • Experience with workflow orchestration and long-running processes (Restate, Temporal, or similar) is a big plus.

  • Expertise in map rendering and geospatial data visualization (Mapbox GL, MapLibre, deck.gl, or similar) is a big plus.

  • Experience with WebGL or GPU rendering is a plus.

  • Comfortable working closely with backend and data teams across a polyglot stack is a plus.

  • Knowledge of infrastructure (Bazel, GCP, Kubernetes) is a plus.

  • Passion and experience building great products. We’d love to hear about things you’ve shipped!

AI as a multiplier

AI is part of how we build every day. We’re looking for engineers with a real grasp of these tools, who use them to multiply their output and not to make up for missing expertise. You should be able to drive an agent through a complex change, judge what it produces, spot where it’s subtly wrong, and stand behind every line that ships.

The bar

We’re looking for exceptional engineers, and we set the bar high on purpose. In return, you’ll get real ownership from day one, products used by millions of people, a team that ships in days rather than quarters, a modern stack with top-tier tooling, and colleagues who will push you to grow.

You don’t need to speak French to apply (and you don’t need perfect English; we’ll help you ramp up quickly).

Life at amo:

To ensure that everyone is set up for success within our way of working, we work together onsite 5 days a week.

We wanted to make sure coming to the office was as comfortable as possible for you:

  • We chose a location in central Paris, near Opera (Metro lines 3,8,9 and RER A).

  • We have a beautiful Parisian-style office with high ceilings, balconies, and huge windows. So a lot of natural light!

Because life outside of work should also be stress-free, we cover:

  • Health care (100% coverage).

  • Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, Second Parent Leave (salary maintained at 100%).

  • Vacation days: 8-9 weeks (total) per year - (European summer? 🥹😎).

    • 5 weeks of paid time off (by the state);

    • 1-2 additional weeks (RTT, based on our company contract);

    • ~11 bank holidays.

We shut down entirely twice a year, two weeks in summer and one week in winter to allow everyone to truly recharge and to avoid prolonged slowdowns (especially in the summer). These pauses are part of your total vacation time, giving everyone a real chance to unplug and recharge. No Slack, no email, no FOMO.

Relocation

  • We love the diverse perspectives we get from having people from all over the world join us (68% of our team is international), and so we of course support relocation to Paris with:

  • Help and sponsored visa process.

  • 1 month of Airbnb 100% covered by amo upon arrival.

About Prelude

Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever.

Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss.

Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US.

But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.

Why join us

Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.

We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.
Our values

  • Care
    We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship.

  • Bias for Action
    We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing in theory.

  • Ownership

We believe conversations will become the #1 way to shop.

At Gorgias, we’re building the platform that makes this real: a unified AI agent that sells, supports, and re-engages customers across the entire journey. Conversational Commerce is the future of ecommerce, and we’re leading that shift.

Our mission is to turn every interaction between a brand and its customers into a relationship: personal, seamless, and intelligent. By combining deep product expertise with the latest in AI, we’re making shopping feel more natural, human, and connected than ever before.

To win, we focus relentlessly on:

  • Quality: conversations that feel authentic and on-brand.

  • Experience: effortless shopping from chat to checkout.

  • Re-engagement: personal, 1-1 dialogue instead of noisy marketing.

The opportunity is massive. As AI reshapes how people buy, Gorgias is building the foundation for the next decade of ecommerce, where every brand has its own intelligent agent and every customer feels understood.

Join us to make Conversational Commerce real.

About the Team

GTM Engineers builds the AI product layer for Gorgias's go-to-market teams: AI agents, internal cockpits, and the automations underneath them, all running on one shared context layer (Cortex). We work across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partnerships. We build and maintain the agents, the business teams own the outputs, and humans review exceptions.

About the Role

You'll own the AI agents that run Gorgias's GTM workflows, taking them from manual process to reviewed agent. The goal is to optimize as much GTM work as possible without losing quality. A strong fit ships working agents quickly, debugs a broken workflow in Cargo, HubSpot, or another GTM tool without waiting for help, and cares whether the business actually uses what gets built.

What You'll Do

  • Navigate between our context layer, our app and service repositories, MCPs, and our automation tools to build and improve end-to-end GTM workflows.

  • Build custom agents and reusable agent skills on our agent stack (Cortex) , and on custom builds when the stack can't do the job.

  • Build and maintain agents for lead and account work: outbound reply handling, audience and call-list building, enrichment, event follow-up, and referral routing.

Who You Are
